Brands We Love

Ashley Basham

Owner & Master Hair Stylist

Born and raised right here in Newark, Lisa and Ashley have created their dream. The two sisters, along with their brother, grew up in a family-owned business. We always knew one day we wanted to start one of our own. After gone through cosmetology school the sisters have each worked apart in different salons. Until one day the opportunity to work together finally came. In 2008 when the economy was crashing Lisa and Ashley decided to purchase a house that was 1,800 sqft that they have transformed into a 5,500 sqft Salon and Spa. We opened Bellezza Salon and Day Spa in 2009 and have since done two additions. Our last addition was in 2022 where we also rebranded to Bellezza and Co adding a boutique to the mix. Lisa and Ashley are still currently behind the chair one day a week and the other time is spent growing the business.

Book with Ashley

Devon

Salon Manager, Director of Education, & Master Stylist

Devon takes immense pride in her roles as both a Salon Manager and Director of Education. As a Master Stylist, she has extensive knowledge of all things hair, specializing in hand-sewn extensions, blonding/lived-in color, and special occasion styling. Her passion extends beyond creating trendy, up-to-date looks—she is also deeply committed to educating and mentoring her team, working alongside them to help refine their skills and grow their confidence. When she’s not behind the chair or leading education, you’ll find her assisting brides, ensuring every detail is in place for their big day. With a lifelong love for the beauty industry, Devon’s enthusiasm and dedication have never wavered. She looks forward to meeting you and bringing your hair goals to life!

Spa Manager & Expert Nail Artist

Stephanie graduated from the American School of Hair Design in 2002 as an advanced manicurist and has been perfecting her craft for over 20 years.
